properties.evidence: That finding located the scorer half of the misses in three one-line shapes in score_tool/term_weights (substring match, stopwords weighted, no length normalisation) and bounded it by ablation. This change is the repair of exactly those three, and is measured against the same 180-query corpus: 53 misses to 42 with no tool regressing. It does NOT repair the finding's other half, the 12 zero-overlap misses, which stay open on the decision.
